entities.summary: Giovanni Antonio Cavazzi da Montecuccolo, OFM Conv. (1621–1678) was an Italian Capuchin missionary priest noted for his travels in 17th century Portuguese Angola and his lengthy account of local history and culture as well as a history of the Capuchin mission there.
